explanation_short: The incremental feature analysis reveals that the inclusion of all 11 features maximizes the predictive power, particularly for the KNN model, which reaches an R² of 0.8179.
explanation_full: Focusing on the incremental feature analysis, the results confirm that the model benefits substantially from the full set of 11 features. Specifically, the KNN model's performance peaks at an R² of 0.8179 and an MSE of 0.0128 when all features are present. This improvement is evident when comparing the performance at 1 feature (R²=0.6449) to the final 11-feature set. This detailed view confirms that the cumulative information from all measured parameters is crucial for building the most robust predictive model for HPR.
